To provide new earning opportunities in villages, we gave record support to self‑help groups.
To free them from the struggle of fetching water, we launched the Har Ghar Nal Se Jal scheme.
To give daughters access to banks, we opened millions of accounts under Jan Dhan Yojana.
Friends, One of Bengal’s great pains has been that in the past 12 years, many central schemes did not reach here on time.
After the BJP government was formed in Bengal, more than 5 million new poor families have been identified to receive permanent houses under PM Awas.
The PM Vishwakarma Yojana has also been implemented here.

candidate_promises.text: That is why I say with great confidence – Together we will build a new Bengal.

items.title: PM’s speech during the inauguration of SEMICON India 2026

candidate_claims.text: Union Cabinet colleagues Ashwini Vaishnaw ji, Jitin Prasada ji, all industry leaders, CEOs, delegates, and virtually connected hundreds of universities and institutes – the future of India, my young companions.
On one side, our centuries‑old tradition of creation, and on the other side, the technology and vision of the 21st century – this is our inspiration for self‑reliant India, for developed India.
If we look at just the past 15 days – I draw your attention only to 15 days – we can see the direction and speed with which India is moving forward.
In this September, just 10 days ago, the Global Fintech Fest was held in Mumbai.
During the same period, nearly 3,000 kilometers of Dedicated Freight Corridor became fully operational in India.
I am talking about September’s 10 days, not long ago.
And even in this challenging period, India achieved 7.8 percent growth.
And this happened after three decades – nearly 35 years.
Its first edition was in 2022.
In the first edition, we talked about policy.
We began talking about projects – from signing files to laying foundation stones.
And this year, we are talking about commercial production.
Wherever semiconductor ecosystems have been built in the world, they have been prepared after decades of effort.
The size of our first phase was about 8 billion dollars, while the second phase we have set at 13.5 billion dollars.
So far, 12 projects have been approved, and in the next phase this scope will expand further.
And as you were told, we have already trained more than 70,000 youth.
Such a large talent pool is nothing less than a gold mine for all of you.
For years, people in your industry talked about transistor size.
In the past two years, the global semiconductor market has grown by more than 20 percent.
And a very big part of this growth is due to demand created by AI.
That means, today if you are working on AI, the challenges are not only about what is inside the chip, but also about what is happening around it.
In the past decade, our installed solar energy capacity has increased from about 2 gigawatts to more than 160 gigawatts – from 2 to 160.
This sector has been opened to private players.
Just a few years ago, our Constitution completed 75 years.
India’s aspirations are before you, and the new opportunities being created in India are ready to welcome you.

candidate_promises.text: As AI expands, the need for computing power will increase at the same pace.

items.title: PM’s address at the BRICS Business Forum 2026

candidate_claims.text: When the group was launched in 2006, it comprised only four countries.
Today, the BRICS countries represent 50% of the world’s population, 40% of global GDP, and more than 25% of global trade.
Not only that, over these years, while global GDP has grown by around 2.5 times, the combined GDP of BRICS countries has grown by around 4.5 times.
In other words, the economic strength of BRICS has grown at nearly twice the pace of the world economy.
The Forum being held in India is the largest-ever BRICS Business Forum.
With more than 200,000 start-ups and over 120 unicorns, India is emerging as a hub for global solutions.
Today, 50% of the world’s real-time payments are powered by this technology.
To build new solutions on this digital layer, we have provided industry and start-ups with an open ecosystem.
Friends, Today, as trade barriers are increasing around the world, India is building economic bridges.
Since 2014, we have entered into Free Trade Agreements with nearly 40 countries around the world.
Therefore, under our Presidency, we have established new cooperation networks in areas such as agriculture, healthcare, skills, and smart grids.
To connect start-ups and SMEs with markets and finance, we have launched initiatives such as the BRICS Incubator Network, BRICS MSME Portal, and BRICS Startup Innovation Fund.
We are very pleased that nearly 200 women business leaders participated in the meeting of this Alliance held in India.

items.title: PM’s remarks at the International Space Summit in Paris via VC

candidate_claims.text: More than 430 satellites from 34 countries have travelled to space aboard Indian rockets.
Working day and night, they have built ISRO’s global reputation mission by mission, success by success, and given India a place of pride among spacefaring nations.
Chandrayan-3 made India the first nation to land near the lunar south pole.
France has been a trusted partner since the Indian space program began at Thumba in the 1960s.

candidate_promises.text: Looking ahead, we aim to establish an Indian space station by 2035 and send an Indian to the Moon by 2040.
Friends, Let the Space Summit in Paris send a clear message: we will explore together, innovate together and protect space together, for all humanity, and for generations to come.
